annotations.text:
A — LAB NOTEBOOK
Warm paper, Spectral serif, typewriter annotations, figures taped in.
Motivation: this is a journey talk and you were a beginner eight weeks ago. It makes that the point.
Tradeoff: least formal. Some supervisors read hand-drawn as under-baked.

B — BROADSHEET
Instrument Serif at 100px, hard rules, one signal red, figures printed big.
Motivation: reads across a room in three seconds and treats your finding as news.
Tradeoff: demands short copy. Anything wordy breaks it.

C — CLINICAL DARK
Near-black ground, luminous data, Chivo and Plex Mono, inverted figures.
Motivation: looks like the machine's own point of view, and the charts glow.
Tradeoff: dark slides depend on the room's projector. Can read cold.
